sources.quote: Company Ventures Go Back Team Portfolio Programs News & Insights Apply Company Ventures is a first check venture firm. We provide founders daily access to a community of excellence, embedded in world class physical space. Learn More We pioneered the Residency model with Grand Central Tech in 2014, built on a single conviction: that working alongside exceptional founders every day is the most powerful accelerant for an early-stage company. Our peers host annual founder summits. We host them daily. As first check investors we identify exceptionally qualified founders and leverage our unique infrastructure to position them to win. We are specifically interested in founders focused on building generational AI companies at the application and data infrastructure / model augmentation layers.
